name: ISS transit across active regions AR4498 and AR4500, 2026
note: H-alpha photograph of the Sun's chromosphere with the International Space Station silhouetted across it, taken 1 August 2026 from Lianyungang, Jiangsu, China, with a Sky-Watcher HELIOSTAR-100Hα solar telescope. Sunspots are visible in the image. I could not view the Sky & Telescope image itself, so the match is not confirmed.
